originalRequests.text: Что нужно сделать, чтобы ты НИКОГДА не подменял мои требования на свои технические предпочтения?
Что нужно сделать для того, чтобы эти контрольные точки появились?
Внедряй контрольные точки. И так, чтобы они работали по всему проекту и в новых окнах, а не только в этом чате.

scope.goal: Implement durable, fail-closed checkpoints that expose and block unapproved substitutions of user requirements across the PolyCopyTrader repository and future Codex sessions.
inScope: Root and Codex-subtree instructions loaded by future tasks
Verbatim machine-readable requirement contracts with assumption and deviation approval
PowerShell validation, regression tests, Codex hooks, Git hooks, and a trusted-base pull-request CI check
Traceability from each literal requirement to changed paths and passing evidence
Independent comparison of the original user prompts against the actual diff
outOfScope: Any production service, database, strategy, order, configuration, or deployment change
Correction or deployment of the separate Reference Average strategy implementation
GitHub branch-protection administration outside repository files
Changing the shared clone hooksPath while unrelated dirty worktrees remain active
scope.periodOrFilter: Whole repository; future non-read-only tasks; no production time window
scope.firstVerification: Inspect root/subtree AGENTS, mandatory Workflow, existing QA, hooks, CI, and shared worktree state before editing.

requirements.text: Repository changes must not replace a user's requirement with an agent's technical preference; assumptions and deviations must be exposed and approved before material edits.
requirements.sourceQuote: НИКОГДА не подменял мои требования на свои технические предпочтения
acceptanceCriteria: A contract stores relevant user prompts verbatim and links each REQ item to an exact source quote.
Any assumption or deviation requires explicit user approval bound to the semantic digest.
Material edits require an approved parent-revision contract; changed governed files map to REQ items and passing verification.
A reviewer other than the author compares the verbatim request, contract, diff, and evidence before completion.
Negative tests demonstrate rejection of missing, stale, unapproved, unmapped, and self-reviewed contracts.

verification.expected: All positive and negative validator lifecycle, approval, coverage, digest, and review cases pass.
verification.evidence: Windows PowerShell 5.1 validator regression harness passed 27/27, including approval lifecycle, staged/index isolation, commit-by-commit range validation, exact context exemptions, immutable completion, bootstrap controls, isolation of successful Git stderr warnings from parsed stdout, and successful in-process native exit-code reset.
git diff --check completed with no whitespace errors after the final implementation edits.

requirements.text: The checkpoints must govern the whole PolyCopyTrader project, not a single strategy or file family.
acceptanceCriteria: All tracked paths except context/history journals and contract records themselves are governed.
Root instructions, QA, staged Git hooks, pre-push range validation, and pull-request CI all invoke the same policy.
Subtree instructions cannot weaken or bypass the root gate.

verification.expected: Whole-repository path coverage and exemption tests pass.
verification.evidence: The 25/25 validator run proved arbitrary governed paths require coverage; only the active context, daily history descendants, and direct contract records are exempt.

requirements.text: The checkpoints must persist into new Codex windows and not depend on this chat's memory.
requirements.sourceQuote: в новых окнах, а не только в этом чате
acceptanceCriteria: Root AGENTS automatically directs every new Codex session to the requirement gate.
Trusted project hooks inject the gate at session, prompt, and subagent starts and block ordinary mutation before exact approval.
Stop validation prevents normal completion with governed changes lacking completed evidence and independent review.
Documentation states the one-time Codex trust step and honestly identifies hook, local-Git, and branch-protection limitations.

verification.expected: Hook tests prove draft-only mutation, exact approval unlock, invalid digest denial, subagent context injection, and stop behavior.
verification.evidence: Windows PowerShell 5.1 Codex hook harness passed 52/52, including new-session/subagent injection, exact approval capture, HEAD-bound activation, completed-contract non-reuse, shell/MCP bypass denial (including nested PowerShell expressions, ripgrep external-command/config paths, and Git cat-file filters), mapped edits, and Stop validation.

verification.command: Parse .codex/hooks.json and inspect official Codex AGENTS/config/hooks documentation.
verification.expected: Hook JSON is valid and event shapes/limitations match official documentation.
verification.evidence: hooks.json and all hook PowerShell files parsed successfully; project trust, exact hook-hash trust, new-session instruction reload, and guardrail limitations were checked against official OpenAI Codex documentation.

verification.expected: Git hook tests prove every pushed ref is validated, force pushes and missing bases fail closed, and installation refuses conflicting hooksPath configuration.
verification.evidence: Windows PowerShell 5.1 Git hook harness passed 31/31, covering multiple pushed refs, deletion, new-ref base, force/non-ancestor denial, malformed/empty stdin, installer idempotence, conflicting hooksPath refusal, and forced LF checkout semantics for both shell hooks.

approval.evidenceText: Внедряй контрольные точки. И так, чтобы они работали по всему проекту и в новых окнах, а не только в этом чате.
